calc_items.title: Compensation check
calc_items.question: HCO₃ 16 mmol/L with measured PCO₂ 43 mmHg. Calculate the expected PCO₂ (Winter) and decide whether compensation is appropriate.
calc_items.working: Expected 1.5×16 + 8 = 32 ±2 mmHg; PCO₂ 43 is above the range, so there is a superimposed respiratory acidosis.
